minutes.headline: Committee approved gathering more information on a 2020 Galapagos student trip and a state student council trip, and heard mental health plans.
minutes.summary: The School Committee approved minutes, heard the superintendent and student representative reports, and considered two student council field trips. It heard a presentation from the new Behavioral Health Advisory Council and the athletic director's winter sports participation report. It waived second reading of several policies, took committee reports, and went into executive session on security.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to have the Galapagos trip advisor gather more information and return for final approval of the June 2020 trip.
A student council trip to the Massachusetts State Conference was approved, with one member recused; members agreed to look into funding for conference costs.
The committee heard a presentation from the new Behavioral Health Advisory Council, including a helpline funded in its first year partly by grants and a donation.
The athletic director reported on winter sports participation and busing, and said a district mini bus would help get students to events.
The committee waived second reading of four policies, appointed two members to the Blue Flag Advisory Committee, and went into executive session on security.

why_it_matters: Student trips and conference costs can fall on families or on the school budget when fundraising falls short, and the committee signalled it may look into funding.
The next meeting takes up budgets, where transportation, a possible mini bus and the continuing cost of the helpline could come up.

The next School Committee meeting, which will take up budgets.
